PROJECT SHINOBI - how to play
=============================

Run ProjectShinobi.exe. There's nothing to install. Windows may warn
because the exe isn't code-signed: click "More info" then "Run anyway".

Keyboard + mouse and controller both work, and you can switch mid-game.
Controller buttons are named Xbox-style below. PlayStation and Nintendo
pads get their own labels in game.

IN THE FIELD                 KEYBOARD + MOUSE        CONTROLLER
  Move                       W A S D                 Left stick
  Camera                     Mouse                   Right stick
  Jump (again in air)        Space                   A
  Dash (tap) / Sprint (hold) Shift                   L3 (click left stick)
  Strike                     Left mouse              X
  Throw kunai                Q                       RT
  Guard (hold)               E                       RB
  Charge chakra (hold)       R                       Y
  Lock on                    Tab / middle mouse      R3
  WEAVE SEALS (hold)         Right mouse             LT
  Quick-cast jutsu 1-4       1 2 3 4                 D-pad
  Pause / settings           Esc                     Start

Kunai aim at whatever is near the middle of the screen, so there's no need
to lock on first.

WEAVING HAND SEALS
  Hold Weave, enter seals, release to cast.
  A seal is a direction, plus an optional bank modifier:

                 Bottom    Right    Left     Top
                 (S / A)   (D / B)  (A / X)  (W / Y)
  Bank I         Rat       Ox       Tiger    Hare
  Bank II        Dragon    Snake    Horse    Ram     (hold Shift / LB)
  Bank III       Monkey    Bird     Dog      Boar    (hold Space / RB)

  Example: Ember Volley = Tiger, Ox = left, right.
  Every jutsu and its seals are in Pause > Jutsu Scroll.
  Too slow between seals and the sequence breaks. Pause > Accessibility
  can widen the timing, turn it off, or switch to toggle mode.

CUSTOMIZE
  Pause > Customize: colours, gear (headband, mask, scarf, sword, pouch),
  height, name, and chakra nature. Jutsu of your nature cost 20% less.

SOUND
  Pause > Accessibility > Audio has Master, Effects and Menu volume.

Settings and your character save to %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Project Shinobi\
